_comment: 3D containment counterexample of review round 3, defect 4: 'a 4.2 m cabinet still
passes in a room with a 2.7 m clear height'.  One 10 x 10 m room with a 2.70 m
ceiling, a 0.9 x 0.4 x 4.2 m external cabinet against the south wall and a harmless
0.9 x 0.4 x 0.9 m one 2.7 m beside it.  Every planar rule passes -- the footprint is
inside the room, the wall gap is 0.10 m (wall hugging), the two pieces do not touch,
the camera is far away and the room stays walkable; only the 3D containment rule can
see that the tall cabinet's top at 4.20 m pokes 1.50 m through the ceiling of room
which must FAIL on furniture_containment for 'tall_cabinet' only.  Remove that item
and the same spec passes every check (tests/test_multifloor.py::ContainmentTest).
